g.text: Monitor only: no power generation, rail disconnect/clamp, transient-fault or fabrication approval. Precision/offset/reference allocations require qualification.

g.desc: Monitor only: no power generation, rail disconnect/clamp, transient-fault or fabrication approval. Precision/offset/reference allocations require qualification.

g.text: E13: eight independent UV/OV windows + coarse5V/3.3V guard. PRE_ANALOG_OK is generated in hardware, independent of MCU firmware.

g.desc: E13: eight independent UV/OV windows + coarse5V/3.3V guard. PRE_ANALOG_OK is generated in hardware, independent of MCU firmware.

g.text: Main-rail fault envelope extends to +/-3.2% with a conditional headroom review; normal generation remains +/-1%. Analog5V generation must be tighter than its4.90..5.10V accepted envelope.

g.desc: Main-rail fault envelope extends to +/-3.2% with a conditional headroom review; normal generation remains +/-1%. Analog5V generation must be tighter than its4.90..5.10V accepted envelope.

g.text: Each open-drain comparator has its own pull-up and hysteresis. Do NOT wire comparator outputs together; use the shown AND tree.

g.desc: Each open-drain comparator has its own pull-up and hysteresis. Do NOT wire comparator outputs together; use the shown AND tree.

g.text: Coarse guard holds qualification low while reference/sense amplifiers start. E09/E11/F02 retain settling and fresh-permit requirements.

g.desc: Coarse guard holds qualification low while reference/sense amplifiers start. E09/E11/F02 retain settling and fresh-permit requirements.
